title: pm: a package's test:repo project is CI's run; a spec-plus-one-package card is build-heavy and goes mode:cloud
body:
Fixes #23607
Clause-②: no

This PR carries out ruling record **6184828752** on #23607, letters **F1 A · F2 A**, which the maintainer approved with 「同意」 on 2026-10-15. It is governed Tier S because it touches `.claude/**`, so it stays in draft until the seat records an at-tier contract review.

## What changes

| file | lines | ceiling |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 400 → 402 (**+2**) | 402, unchanged: the two lines use the file's existing headroom of 2, so the row moves by 0 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` | 185 → 188 (**+3**) | 185 → 188 (**+3**), a ruled raise |
| `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` | +21 / −1 | only the `execution-duties.md` `CEILINGS` row, with a comment block above it in the shape of the 183 → 185 block |

**F1**: two lines in `os-dev.md` 〈本地验证范围〉, placed right after item ②'s two continuation lines and before ③. Items ①–③ are unchanged.

```text
- ② 不含 `test:repo`(vitest `repo` 项目):它归 CI,`Test Core` 在 PR 与 merge group 都跑。
- 仅 diff 改该项目测试或派生清单点名它时本地跑,否则 `deviations` 写明;席位 ACCEPT 读其 CI。
```

**F2**: three lines in `execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉, placed right after the `mode:cloud` line. The ruling cites that line as `:142`. It was L144 at this branch's base, because #23660 inserted two lines above it.

```text
- 申报文件面写 `packages/spec/src/**` 且至少另一包 ⇒ build 重,派 `mode:cloud`,一卡一容器。
- 一容器同时至多跑一个 build 重子代理;云会话建闭包拉 turbo 远程缓存。
- 首张这类派发实测固定开销(安装 + 拉缓存)并记在其卡上。
```

The `mode:cloud` line itself is unchanged, including 「build 重的 M 卡逐卡判」. The ruled test is a sufficient condition: the card asked 「命中就走云卡」. An M card that misses the test is still judged one card at a time.

## The ruling, verbatim (comment 6184828752, items 1 and 2)

> 1. **F1 A.** A package's `test:repo` project is CI's run (`ci.yml` runs `test test:repo` on the merge group). A dev runs it locally only when the diff edits a `repo`-project test file or the derived `--commands` list names it; otherwise the dev's `deviations` line says so, and the seat's ACCEPT reads the PR's CI for that project. `os-dev.md`'s local-verification section carries the sentence.
> 2. **F2 A.** `execution-duties.md:142` gets the test: a card whose declared file surface writes `packages/spec/src/**` and at least one other package is build-heavy and is dispatched `mode:cloud`, one container per such card; a container runs at most one build-heavy subagent at a time. The cloud session pulls the turbo remote cache for the closure; the first such dispatch measures its fixed cost (install plus cache pull) and records it on its card.

Item 3 is respected: `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and the environment are not touched. Item 4 is another seat's interim duty and is not done here.

## Ruled raise: ruling id and measured delta

This follows the raise form named in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`'s header since #23668 landed (merged into this branch). The ordering ruling is **6184828752** (letters F1 A · F2 A). The authorization is ruling record **6184799323** on #23606, **letter B, item 1**, verbatim:

> 1. A ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file is the authorization to raise that file's ceiling by the measured lines the text needs: the raising PR quotes the ruling comment's id and the measured line delta in its body, and moves the `CEILINGS` row in the same PR by at most that delta. No second word from the maintainer is needed.

Measured deltas:
- **`execution-duties.md`: +3 lines.** The row moves 185 → 188, exactly that delta.
  - The tightest one-line spelling of the four ruled parts is 245 B, against the 120 B per-line cap.
  - No two-line split fits. The test plus the per-container limit needs 137 B at its tightest. The per-container limit plus the cache part plus the fixed-cost part needs 141 B.
  - The three lines land at 112 B, 95 B and 79 B.
- **`os-dev.md`: +2 lines.** These fit the standing headroom of 2, so the row stays at 402 and moves by 0.
  - The tightest one-line spelling is 131 B.
  - The two lines land at 101 B and 119 B.

Ratchet verdict lines at the final head:

```text
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md is 188 lines (ceiling 188; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/agents/os-dev.md is 402 lines (ceiling 402; headroom 0).
```

The per-line byte rule prints only on failure. The run printed zero `✗` lines.

## Premises re-checked on `origin/main`

- `git grep -n "turbo run test test:repo" origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml` exited 0 and hit `ci.yml:965`. The control, `merge_group` in the same file, exited 0 with 27 hits, the first at `:40`.
- One measured refinement to the ruling's parenthetical. The `Test Core` job's `if:` (`ci.yml:501`) has no event exclusion, unlike the four full-battery jobs that spell `github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'`. So `test test:repo` runs on `pull_request` (affected packages) as well as on `merge_group`.
  - The F1 line therefore says 「PR 与 merge group 都跑」. That is also what lets the seat's ACCEPT read the PR's CI.
- Line counts at base `94924e01c`: 400 / 402 and 185 / 185. The PM's readings at `57994c311` held.

## Verification (head `4428e1746`, after the final commit)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived **39 commands**.
  - The change set was 3 paths against merge base `547702080` (+26 / −1).
  - The list is identical to the derivation at `0f02a71ce`, taken before the second merge of `origin/main`.
- All 39 commands ran locally and exited 0, each exit code captured before any pipe.
  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` was run with `nohup` and waited on with `tail --pid`. It printed `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1884 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred.` (268 s on this box) and exited 0.
- The `--ran` reconciliation printed `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 39 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- The edited script's own suite, `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`, passed 164 cases and exited 0. The plain run exited 0. No `*.test.ts` names the script.
- Two roster families that read the ratchet are not in the derived list. Both were run anyway and exited 0: `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because a fresh worktree had no `dist/` for `@objectstack/formula` or `@objectstack/lint`.
  - Both were built under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`) and the gate was re-run: exit 0. Nothing was measured on the first run, so it is not a finding.
- What was not run, and why:
  - No package is touched, so there is no ① closure build and no ② package tests.
  - `test:repo` was not run locally. The diff edits no `repo`-project test and the derived list does not name it, which is the F1 rule applied to itself.
  - No ablation: the diff is agent text plus one ceiling number, and no tested behaviour changes.
- CI runs the full farm on this PR. The seat's ACCEPT reads its check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- The report JSON template in `os-dev.md` has no `deviations` key. Yet the ruled F1 line, two earlier `os-dev.md` lines and dispatch orders all name a `deviations` field. This is noted here and not filed: it is a consistency gap in agent text with no runtime face. 承接者:无.
- The dev ran at `TIER_DEFAULT` under the claim's measured quota exemption. The at-tier contract review is still owed before landing.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
- 开发 agent 规则 `os-dev.md` 加两行:
  - 包的 `test:repo`(全仓扫描类测试)不算「本包自己的测试」,归 CI 跑。
  - 只有改了这类测试本身,或派生门禁清单点名它时,才在本地跑;否则在报告里写明。席位验收看 PR 上的 CI 结果。
- 席位派发规则 `execution-duties.md` 加三行:
  - 声明要改 `packages/spec/src/**`、且至少还改另一个包的卡,算「build 重」,派云端独立容器,一卡一容器。
  - 一个容器同时最多跑一个这类开发 agent。云端会话用 turbo 远程缓存建依赖。
  - 第一张这样派出的卡要实测固定开销(装依赖 + 拉缓存),并记在卡上。
- 行数上限:`execution-duties.md` 185 → 188(+3,按裁决授权抬升)。`os-dev.md` 正好用完原有余量 2 行,上限 402 不动。

**为什么改**
- 执行你 10-15 对决策卡的「同意」(F1 A · F2 A)。
- 实测:容器里共享验证锁 2 小时内被占 89%,三个开发 agent 累计排队约 3.5 小时。
- 本地跑 `test:repo` 两次就占了 26%;另有三张要反复构建 spec 的重卡挤在同一个容器里。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- `test:repo` 的失败会晚到 PR 的 CI 上才出现,大约多一个 CI 周期(中位约 23 分钟);换来的是本地每次少占锁 13–15 分钟。
- 重卡走云端,每张多付一次装依赖与拉缓存的固定开销;首张实测后记卡。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即可。只有规则文字和一个上限数字,不涉及代码,也不发布任何包。

**席位意见**

**你要做的**
- 无需操作。本 PR 属 Tier S,由席位做完达档合约复核 PASS 后落地。
